lines.zh: 我摆六片鳍，贴着水底走。
lines.en: I work all six fins and skim the bottom.

lines.zh: 我的身体细长，像一根带刺的绳。
lines.en: I'm long and thin, like a spiked cord.

lines.zh: 前面两对鳍划水，后面一对掌舵。
lines.en: Two pairs row, the last pair steers.
The weeds part where I swim.
My teeth splay outward and won't close.

lines.zh: 我贴着淤泥滑，不扬起沙。
lines.en: I slide over silt without raising sand.

lines.zh: 六条肢，是祖上留下来的。
lines.en: Six limbs, handed down from my ancestors.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里挤过去，鳍折着。
lines.en: I squeeze through a rock gap, fins folded.

lines.zh: 浅水里我慢，深水里我快。
lines.en: Slow in the shallows, quick in the deep.
I follow the current all the way down.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴很细，摆动得快。
lines.en: My tail is thin and beats quickly.

lines.zh: 我从你的影子底下游过去。
lines.en: I swim beneath your shadow.

lines.zh: 这水底的石头，我一块块绕。
lines.en: I go around the stones one by one.
I stop, and my fins keep moving.
The current pushes and I drift with it.
I swim steady as a seam.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，六鳍慢慢扇。
lines.en: I hang in the water, six fins fanning slowly.
My teeth grow inward and cannot retract.
A little shrimp crawls over my back.

lines.zh: 六肢的祖先，在水里不出声。
lines.en: A six-limbed ancestor makes no sound in water.
I press to the stone and don't move.
The water moves. I don't.

lines.zh: 我在等东西从上面下来。
lines.en: I'm waiting for something to come down.
My color matches the bottom.

lines.zh: 我慢慢侧过身，露出肚子。
lines.en: I slowly turn, showing my belly.

lines.zh: 六条肢收在身下，很整齐。
lines.en: Six limbs tucked beneath me, neat.
I'm listening to the water.

lines.zh: 气泡从石头缝里冒出来。
lines.en: Bubbles rise from the rock seams.
I'm hungry, and I don't want to move.
A fin tip touches sand and I lift it.
The water reaches your knees and my back.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在两侧，看得很广。
lines.en: My eyes are wide-set and see a lot.
Did you notice my teeth?

lines.zh: 你一动，水就把消息传给我。
lines.en: When you move, the water tells me.
This skeleton of mine has six limbs.

lines.zh: 你弯腰看水，我抬头看你。
lines.en: You bend to the water; I look up at you.
I'm not much to look at, am I.

lines.zh: 手伸进水里，就别缩回去。
lines.en: Once your hand is in the water, do not pull it back.

lines.zh: 我认得你的影子，第二次了。
lines.en: I know your shadow. Second time now.
You back away and I sink.
I roll half over, then right myself.

lines.zh: 泥沙被搅起来，我看不清。
lines.en: Silt is stirred up and I can't see.
A corner of my fin is gone.
I press under a stone.
The pain keeps my teeth from closing.
Blood comes from behind my gills.
I retreat a long way before stopping.

lines.zh: 打偏了我的鳞，我记着你。
lines.en: You scraped my scales; I will remember you.
There's nowhere else on the bottom.
I can only wait for it to pass.
That's the smell of meat.
It's sinking. I see it.
I swim up slowly, unhurried.
One tremble from you and the ripples spoil.
My mouth hangs open, teeth waiting.
That piece would feed me a day.
Move back. I'm coming up.
Following the smell, I circle once.
It's hit the bottom. Mine.
When I'm done I'll still be here.
I bump your foot and slide away.
My fin scrapes your boot.

lines.zh: 泥被搅起来，水一下浑了。
lines.en: The silt lifts and the water turns cloudy.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的牙磕在石头上。
lines.en: That knocked my teeth against stone.
I pull back half a foot and come again.
You don't move, so I go around.

lines.zh: 我的身体很软，撞不疼你。
lines.en: I'm soft; the bump won't hurt you.
Afterward I settle to the bottom.
Your foot moves and I back off.
We pass each other and neither stops.
My own kind, downstream.
We run side by side along the bottom.
Its six fins are broader than mine.

lines.zh: 我们的尾巴交叉，又分开。
lines.en: Our tails cross, then part.
The eggs will catch in the rock seams.

lines.zh: 水流会替我们带走它们。
lines.en: The current will carry them off for us.
We don't need to guard them.
Not many will survive in this water.
But we lay enough.
Then we swim apart.
I bite and swallow it down.

lines.zh: 我这副六足骨架，是演化猜的。
lines.en: This six-limbed frame is an evolutionary guess.

lines.zh: 我咬着它，塞进石头下面。
lines.en: I carry it in my teeth under a stone.

lines.zh: 它还在扭，我咬紧了不松。
lines.en: It's still writhing. I clamp down.
Two bites and a bit broke off.
There's always something to pick up down here.
I pin it with a fin, then bite.
That mouthful had sand in it.
I spat out the shell.
Afterward I rest against the stone.
The ripples are spreading wrong.
Something's on the surface.
I see its feet.
It's still wading in.
I flatten myself against the bottom.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我游两下就到。
lines.en: From here, two strokes.

lines.zh: 牙全长在外头，我不用张嘴。
lines.en: My teeth are always out; I need not open my mouth.

lines.zh: 泥里只剩我的眼睛在动。
lines.en: Only my eyes move in the mud.
I've picked this angle.
Now its foot has gone deep.
I follow it along the bottom.

lines.zh: 它的脚搅起泥，遮住了我。
lines.en: Its feet stir mud that hides me.

lines.zh: 我贴着河底，绕到它后头。
lines.en: I hug the riverbed and get behind it.
It turns and I stop.
The taste in the water is getting closer.
All six of my fins are moving.
It's wading deeper.
The water's clouded. Just as I like it.
It's slow in deep water.
It's slow. I'm not.
I bite and my teeth hook in.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住，撕下一片鳞。
lines.en: I bite down and tear off a plate of scale.

lines.zh: 牙咬在石头上，崩了一下。
lines.en: My teeth hit stone and jar.
I coil my body around it once.
It kicks and the surge throws me off.
The blood spreads slowly in the water.
I bite again, deeper.
It retreats and I follow.
I can't bite through its boot.
I sink back and wait.

lines.zh: 我从沙里钻出来，六鳍张开。
lines.en: I rise from the sand, six fins spread.
The water's warmer than I remember.

lines.zh: 我先试着水流，再挑方向。
lines.en: I test the current, then pick a direction.
There's still egg casing on my fins.
I swim one lap along the bottom.
This channel has room to hide.
The light is above; I stay below.

lines.zh: 我找了一块石头，伏在下面。
lines.en: I find a stone and lie under it.

lines.zh: 水底的东西，都会掉下来。
lines.en: Everything at the bottom fell from above.
I lie below and wait for them.
The water burns and my gills clamp shut.

lines.zh: 六条鳍撑着我，被甩上石头。
lines.en: Six fins held me up, then I hit stone.

lines.zh: 水太浅，我的鳃贴着空气。
lines.en: The water's too shallow; my gills press on air.

lines.zh: 炸响把整条水道都掀了。
lines.en: The blast lifts the whole channel.

lines.zh: 一支箭从上面扎下来，穿进我背。
lines.en: An arrow comes down and pins my back.

lines.zh: 一道光在水里追我，躲不开。
lines.en: A light chases me through the water. No escape.

lines.zh: 水底空了很久，我瘦成一条线。
lines.en: The bottom's been empty so long I'm down to a line.

lines.zh: 雷打在水里，我全身都直了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water and my whole body goes rigid.
No water. My fins row at nothing.
